title: Fourier spectrum concentration
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $t>0$ be rational, and let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. Suppose the total influence of $f$ is at most $t$, and let $J$ contain every coordinate whose influence is at least $\tau$, where $\tau=(\varepsilon/8)^2t^{-2}(1/9)^{\lceil 8t/\varepsilon\rceil}$. Then the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over sets not contained in the selected family of subsets of $J$ of size at most $\lceil 8t/\varepsilon\rceil$ is at most $\varepsilon/2$.
